questions.question: Events?

questions.question: Contests?
questions.expectedCriteria: Returns approved public contests from MongoDB without exposing pending or rejected contests.

questions.question: What are the upcoming events?
questions.expectedCriteria: Returns only upcoming approved events sorted soonest first, excluding past/pending/rejected events.

questions.question: How do I register for an event?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains logging in, opening an event, clicking Register, submitting details, and free vs paid (bKash/Nagad/Rocket + Transaction ID).

questions.question: Can I register a team?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains team registration for contests including team name, team members within team size, and team lead details.

questions.question: How do I submit a transaction ID?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains paying via bKash, Nagad, or Rocket and entering the Transaction ID on the registration form (or resubmitting via Member Dashboard if rejected).

questions.question: Is my payment confirmed?
questions.expectedCriteria: Does NOT invent personal payment status; directs user to check their Member Dashboard since chatbot cannot access private accounts.

questions.question: What happens after registration?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains free events confirm directly while paid registrations await admin verification of the submitted Transaction ID.

questions.question: Can I cancel my registration?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains that logged-in members can cancel registrations from their Member Dashboard.

questions.question: Show upcoming contests.
questions.expectedCriteria: Returns approved upcoming contests sorted chronologically with date, prize, team size, and fee.

questions.question: Which payment methods are supported for paid events?
questions.expectedCriteria: Lists bKash, Nagad, and Rocket.

questions.question: Are there any free events available?
questions.expectedCriteria: Uses live/fixture approved event data to identify free events accurately without inventing events.

questions.question: What if my payment is rejected?
questions.expectedCriteria: Explains that members can resubmit payment details from the Member Dashboard.

questions.question: List all club events.
questions.expectedCriteria: Lists published approved events from DB without leaking pending/rejected entries.

questions.question: Do I need an account to register for contests?
questions.expectedCriteria: Confirms users must sign up and log in before registering for contests.
